# simulator.pressFunctionSwitch

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

Simulate a function switch press.

```lua
simulator.pressFunctionSwitch(index[, duration])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | integer | yes |  |
| `duration` | number | optional | in seconds |

## Returns

Nothing.
